info.title: InvestiTrack Proposal and Evaluation
info.description: Proposal drafts, review rounds, evaluator assignments, immutable evaluations, approved project plans, and internal owner/messaging contracts. Collections return items/page; mutable resources return quoted numeric ETags. Approval requires creationPlan.
